description: Import a doc OR page from a Markdown body — the universal Markdown→content bridge. target='doc' parses Markdown into a Tiptap doc body; target='page' parses prose runs into rich_text blocks. `:::component{slug=… version=… props={…}}` directives become embedded components (the MDX unlock). Create a NEW item (omit the id, pass slug + title) or REPLACE an existing one's body/blocks (pass doc_id for a doc / page_id for a page). The Phase 11+12 gate is opt-in via dry_run/confirm_token and applies on the REPLACE path (omit both ⇒ immediate). Round-trips with content_export_markdown. Markdown is capped at 256 KB.

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

doc_id.description: Existing doc to replace (target='doc'); omit to create.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without mutating and receive a confirm_token. When omitted, the change is applied immediately (legacy behaviour preserved).

markdown.description: Markdown source (≤256 KB). `:::component{...}` directives are preserved.

page_id.description: Existing page to replace blocks on (target='page'); omit to create.

parent_id.description: Parent doc/page id (nesting on create; doc re-path on update).

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

slug.description: Flat slug — required when creating, ignored when updating (slug is immutable).

target.description: What to create/update from the Markdown.

title.description: Required when creating; updates the title when set on an existing item.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_import_markdown
